premise: A summer shower falls in the middle of a beach day; everyone splashes and laughs, and when it stops a rainbow arches over the bay.
inspiration: The weather-turn of the folk tale (the storm that brings the gift), made small and sunny: the shower is the fun, the rainbow the gift.
lesson: A little rain can be part of a good day.

en-US.title: A Shower at the Beach
en-US.text: [excited] What a sunny day for the beach! {all:hop} Everyone is busy playing. And then… [playfully] plip. {all:face surprised} What was that? Plip. Plop. {canvas:rain 0.7 16s} {sfx:rain} Pitter-patter, pitter-patter… a summer shower, right in the middle of a beach day! {all:shake} Everyone wiggles. {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} Some hop. Some splash. Some just tip their faces up to the rain and laugh. [laughs] The sea doesn't mind one bit. {all:wobble} It's wet already! [short pause] Then the rain slows down… drip… drop… and stops. {canvas:rainbow 12s} [gasps] {all:face surprised} Look! A rainbow, right over the bay! {all:sparkle} Red and orange, yellow and green, blue and violet. {all:face happy} {all:hearts} [happily] And everyone agrees: a little rain makes a very good rainbow.

es-ES.title: Un chaparrón en la playa
es-ES.text: [excited] ¡Qué día de sol para ir a la playa! {all:hop} Todos están jugando. Y entonces… [playfully] plic. {all:face surprised} ¿Qué ha sido eso? Plic. Ploc. {canvas:rain 0.7 16s} {sfx:rain} Tip-tap, tip-tap… ¡un chaparrón de verano, en plena mañana de playa! {all:shake} Todos se sacuden. {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} Unos saltan. Otros chapotean. Otros levantan la cara hacia la lluvia y se ríen. [laughs] Al mar no le importa nada. {all:wobble} ¡Ya estaba mojado! [short pause] Luego la lluvia va más despacio… plic… ploc… y para. {canvas:rainbow 12s} [gasps] {all:face surprised} ¡Mirad! ¡Un arcoíris sobre la bahía! {all:sparkle} Rojo y naranja, amarillo y verde, azul y violeta. {all:face happy} {all:hearts} [happily] Y todos están de acuerdo: un poco de lluvia trae un arcoíris buenísimo.

rain.prompt: a light summer rain shower pattering on sand and on the sea, realistic field recording
